entries.outcome: an empty fleet list keeps nothing, deletes nothing and reads no thread
entries.testName: prune - an empty fleet list deletes nothing and keeps nothing
entries.flipWentRed: deleting the early return made the test go red: the thread read was issued

entries.outcome: a comment a non-fleet account wrote is filtered out and never kept or deleted
entries.testName: self-schedule - a stranger's announcement marker is never deleted (Issue #3597)
entries.flipWentRed: replacing the fleet filter with every comment made it go red: the stranger's marker counted as the announcement, so ours was never posted

entries.outcome: no fleet-authored marker comment returns null and deletes nothing
entries.testName: prune - returns null and deletes nothing when no fleet comment carries the marker
entries.flipWentRed: throwing instead of returning null made this test and the held-gate posting tests go red

entries.outcome: a duplicate DELETE GitHub answers as not found counts as already removed
entries.testName: prune - a DELETE answered with HTTP 404 counts as already deleted
entries.flipWentRed: not tolerating a not-found delete made the already-removed test go red

entries.outcome: any other delete failure is thrown, naming every duplicate that was not deleted
entries.testName: prune - a DELETE refused with HTTP 403 throws, naming every failed comment
entries.flipWentRed: swallowing the failures made the HTTP 403 test go red

entries.outcome: after a POST the thread is pruned again, so a racing run's duplicate is removed

entries.flipWentRed: removing the prune after the POST made the concurrent-upsert test go red

entries.outcome: a kept comment that already carries the key is left unchanged
entries.testName: upsertHeldIssueGateComment - an unchanged gate writes nothing, a changed gate edits in place
entries.flipWentRed: flipping the unchanged check made three tests go red

entries.outcome: a v1 recheck-cache entry from before the prune existed is ignored, so the thread is read and pruned
entries.testName: reportHeldIssueGate - a warm pre-#3597 cache entry does not hide existing duplicates (Issue #3597)
entries.flipWentRed: restoring the v1 key made the test go red: the outcome was cached, not unchanged

entries.outcome: the fleet identity is resolved once per scan, not once per issue

entries.flipWentRed: resolving on every issue made the test go red: the config loader ran twice
